name: viiibin design system

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground (iii background: 220 20% 8% / 220 20% 96%).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Cards and panels at 60 % over the ground (iii card).

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: Chip fills, the selected row, tiles inside cards (iii secondary / muted).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: frames, dividers, card edges (iii border).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Control borders and the selector at rest: 3:1 or better on ground and glass.

tokens.name: lit
tokens.usage: Structure and progress: the lit arc of a ring, links, the current step. iii purple (purple-light on dark).

tokens.name: on-lit
tokens.usage: Text on a solid lit fill.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and figures; also the black (or white) primary button (iii foreground).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, second headline lines (iii muted-foreground).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: iii purple: the section tick, icons, Approve, chips, the purple color block.

tokens.name: purple-dark
tokens.usage: Gradients and the third color block only.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: A person's decision: pending approvals (with the diamond shape) and decision-ledger entries.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on a solid brand fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Pointed at: hover, focus and the selector corners, in the foreground color. Never a resting state.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid accent fill.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status ON TRACK. Always beside its word.

tokens.name: watch
tokens.usage: Status AT RISK. Always beside its word.

tokens.name: fault
tokens.usage: Status BLOCKED (iii destructive). Always beside its word.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Status DONE, APPROVED, MERGED, VERIFIED. Always beside its word.

tokens.name: paused
tokens.usage: Status PAUSED. Always beside its word.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one title on a screen or the Continue card (iii h1, 40 px under 1024 px). Sentence case; nothing heavier than medium.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles, door names at 14 px. Sentence case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels over readings, in sentence case, in dim.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Area codes, IDs and keys, in DM Mono.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section labels in sentence case with the 2 px primary tick on their left (iii Label + tick).

styles.name: summary
styles.sample: 7 features wait on the client; building starts when they are decided.
styles.usage: The one-sentence summary that opens every detail panel.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The data migration slipped nine days after the vendor missed the extract window.
styles.usage: Notes, descriptions, decision text. Sentence case.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Secondary lines inside plates and rows.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: IDs, hashes and code only. Figures use the body face with tabular numerals.

styles.name: figure-row
styles.usage: A row's headline figure, tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside chips and between a label and its reading.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows in a plate.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: The grid gutter: between plates, and from plates to the window edge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Plate padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups on a board.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Board padding from the window.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The gap between the instrument and its cards.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: The safe frame: the margin between every floating element and the window's edge, written clamp(16px, 3vw, 44px). Nothing floats beyond it, the agent panel included.

tokens.name: radius-base
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, the role switch (iii --radius).

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Status chips, counts, eyebrow badges, keys.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Tiles inside cards, icon squares.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Doors, rows, figure tiles, needs-you items, cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The detail panel, the onboarding dialog, the transition frame, the dock.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Tiny status dots only. No pills.

chamfer.note: The softened chamfer: one cut corner (top right) with every point eased, drawn as an SVG outline that redraws with its element (the softPath recipe in bundle.js). Lead surfaces only: the Continue card and the detail panel.

tokens.name: softcut-cut
tokens.usage: How far the corner is cut, at most 7 % of the width.

tokens.name: softcut-ease
tokens.usage: How far each point is eased; the cut's two points ease 1.3 times as far (about 8 px), so the cut still reads as a cut.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Only under a floating panel (the onboarding dialog, the dock). No glows anywhere.

duration.note: Timings from Fleet Command's built transitions.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and focus states: lift, brackets, leader color.

tokens.name: dur-glance
tokens.usage: A flow glance fading in, after a 120 ms settle.

tokens.name: dur-open
tokens.usage: A board growing from its card's corner.

tokens.name: dur-flip-out
tokens.usage: The leaving board when the wheel flips.

tokens.name: dur-flip-in
tokens.usage: The arriving board when the wheel flips.

tokens.name: dur-lift
tokens.usage: The loader lifting off a ready page.

tokens.name: ease-open
tokens.usage: Boards, glances, tendrils drawing out.

tokens.name: ease-flip
tokens.usage: The wheel flip and the loader's fill.

layout.note: Layout lockups: grid compositions more than one view uses. Views read them as var(--layout-<name>).

tokens.name: layout-hub
tokens.usage: A main view: the work in the wide column, Continue and Needs you on the right.

tokens.name: layout-doors
tokens.usage: A row of doors: every card at 220 px or more.

tokens.name: layout-plates
tokens.usage: A dialog screen's plates under its chart.

tokens.name: layout-row
tokens.usage: A status list row: the name, the status word, the action.
